BEAT 3 OF 5

How is titin built, and what changes during stretch?

Build and stretch the spring

During stretch, folded-domain chains straighten and flexible I-band segments extend while titin’s A-band span stays fixed in this model and predicted passive force rises.

Framing the spring and scaffold for stretch while preserving your current sarcomere length.
